BURHAN:v3p471/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p471/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p471/r2.claim: The three groups of wrongdoers, the moderate, and the foremost cover everyone; the matching three in al-Wāqiʿa are the people of the left, the people of the right, and the foremost.
BURHAN:v3p471/r2.anchor: وأصحاب المشأمة هم الظالمون لأنفسهم وأصحاب الميمنة هم المقتصدون والسابقون هم السابقون بالخيرات

STUDYQURAN:56:intro/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:intro/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:56:intro/r4.claim: Its central theme is the Hereafter's fate for the foremost, companions of the right, and companions of the left; it continues and completes al-Rahman by contrasting Paradise's blessings with Hell's punishments.
STUDYQURAN:56:intro/r4.anchor: this sūrah can be seen as a continuation and completion of it

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r4.claim: Judgment will replace worldly standards of rank: believers with faith and good works attain honor, while those absorbed in worldly life face Hell.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r4.anchor: the values and standards of respect and humiliation will be entirely different from what they are witnessing in this world

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r5.claim: Verses 1–10 assert the certain arrival of Judgment, which evaluates faith and deeds and divides humanity into three groups.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r5.anchor: The Day shall evaluate a person according to his faith and deeds; it shall upgrade many a people and downgrade many

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r1.claim: The elevation and abasement of verse 3 takes the form of three human groups: the right-hand companions, left-hand companions, and the foremost.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r1.anchor: on that day, mankind will be divided into three groups

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r4.claim: The foremost are early adopters of true religion who served it with their persons and wealth when the few supporters faced danger.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r4.anchor: people who were foremost in accepting the calls of the true religion

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p139/r5.claim: Al-Ḥadīd says those who spent and fought before the conquest of Makkah have greater status than those who did so afterward, though God promises both good reward.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r3.claim: In al-sābiqūna al-sābiqūn, the second noun is the predicate; the concise repetition eloquently marks a rank beyond imagining.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r3.anchor: the brevity found in it has great eloquence in it

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r4.claim: These names do not arrange people spatially before God: right, left, front, and back make no sense there, and the left-hand group’s abode is Hell.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r4.anchor: the concept of right and left, front and back is a meaningless one

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r6.claim: The distinction between the right-hand companions and the foremost was mentioned earlier, with further explanation to come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p140/r6.anchor: I have already alluded to it earlier and more explanation is coming up

RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r1.claim: One parsing coordinates the first al-sābiqūn with the people of the right; the following clause then says those are the brought near.
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r1.anchor: والسابقون } عطف على { وأصحاب * الميمنة } ( الواقعة : 8 )

RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r2.claim: Repetition can mark the subject's renown, so no predicate is needed; Rāzī cites a poet's line أنا أبو النجم وشعري شعري as an example.
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r2.anchor: شهرة أمر المبتدأ بما هو عليه فلا حاجة إلى الخبر عنه وهو مراد الشاعر

RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r3.claim: Alternatively, repetition says their condition surpasses human knowledge, like being able to describe a king only as a king.
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r3.anchor: أن في المبتدأ مالا يحيط العلم به ولا يخبر عنه ولا يعرف منه

RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r4.claim: Unlike the question about the people of the right, the forerunners are not challenged to explain themselves because they already admit human inability to grasp their state.
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r4.anchor: الاستفهام الذي للإعجاز يورد على مدعي العلم

RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r5.claim: Rāzī prefers the repeated-subject reading as the most balanced and sound explanation.

RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r6.claim: A further explanation is that those who race to good works in this life will be the first to Paradise in the next.
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r6.anchor: أن المراد منه أن السابقين إلى الخيرات في الدنيا هم السابقون إلى الجنة في العقبى

RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r7.claim: A third parsing treats the second al-sābiqūn as an emphatic repetition of the first.
RAZI-FULL:v29p127#3/r7.anchor: وثالثها : هو أن السابقون ثانيا تأكيد

RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r4.claim: The discourse first names those affected by the warnings, then explains the forerunners before the people of the left because the forerunners' merit deserves priority in this exposition.
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r4.anchor: عند البيان فذكر السابق لفضيلته وفضيلة حاله

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r1.claim: Al-sābiqūn comes from sabaqa, meaning to go first, go ahead, outstrip, or win a race.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r1.anchor: The foremost translates al-sābiqūn, which derives from the verb sabaqa

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r2.speaker: Aj, Z
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r2.claim: Repeating the same word as subject and complement expresses something great and universally known.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r2.anchor: the same word is the subject and the complement, is used to express something that is great and known to all (Aj, Z)

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r3.speaker: Many commentators
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r3.claim: Many identify the foremost as the community's spiritual elite, who understand religion's inner meaning and walk toward God in this life.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r3.anchor: Many identify them with the spiritual elite of the community, who understand the inner meaning of the religion and walk toward God in this life.

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r4.speaker: Most commentators
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r4.claim: Most commentators identify the foremost as the prophets.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r4.anchor: Most commentators consider the foremost to be the prophets (IK, JJ)

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r5.speaker: Some commentators
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r5.claim: Some include saints, the truthful, and martyrs with the prophets because they outstrip others in faith.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r5.anchor: Some include the saints, the truthful

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r6.speaker: Others
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r6.claim: Others hold that the prophets are beyond the foremost.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r6.anchor: while others believe the prophets to be beyond the foremost (Aj)

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r7.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r7.speaker: Aj, IK, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r7.claim: Other interpretations identify them as the first to accept Islam.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r7.anchor: Other interpretations include: the first to accept Islam (Aj, IK, Ṭ)

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r8.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r8.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r8.claim: Another interpretation identifies them as the first members of the religious community, or ummah.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r8.anchor: the first members of the religious community

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r9.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r9.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r9.claim: They may be the sincere, foremost in answering God's call and sacrificing in pursuit of His Contentment.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r9.anchor: who are foremost in responding to the

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r10.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r10.speaker: IK, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r10.claim: They may be the first to come to the mosque and the first to set out in God's way.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r10.anchor: the first to come to the mosque, and the first to set out in the way of God (IK, Ṭ)

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r11.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r11.speaker: Aj
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r11.claim: Another view identifies them as those foremost in attaining virtue.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r11.anchor: those who are foremost in attaining virtue (Aj)

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r12.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r12.speaker: IK
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r12.claim: Some interpret the foremost as residents of the highest parts of Heaven, associated with 83:18.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r12.anchor: the residents of the highest parts of Heaven (see 83:18; IK)

STUDYQURAN:56:10/r13.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r13.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r13.claim: Some say the foremost bypass Reckoning and go directly to Paradise, while the companions of the left and right stand for judgment.
STUDYQURAN:56:10/r13.anchor: the foremost will not be subject to the Reckoning before God on the Day of Judgment, going straight to Paradise

TAB-FULL:v22p288/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r1.claim: The foremost are the third group: those who preceded others in faith in God and His Messenger, namely the earliest Emigrants.
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r1.anchor: فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «سوى بين أصحاب اليمين من الأمم السابقة، وبين أصحاب اليمين من هذه الأمة، وكان السابقون من الأمم أكثر من سابقي هذه الأمة»

TAB-FULL:v22p288/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r4.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r4.claim: The Prophet says right-hand people from earlier nations and this community are equal in number, while earlier nations had more foremost people.
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r4.anchor: فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «سوى بين أصحاب اليمين من الأمم السابقة، وبين أصحاب اليمين من هذه الأمة، وكان السابقون من الأمم أكثر من سابقي هذه الأمة»

TAB-FULL:v22p288/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r7.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r7.claim: Qatāda says the foremost come from every community.
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r7.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {فأصحاب الميمنة ما أصحاب الميمنة} [الواقعة: 8] «أي ماذا لهم، وماذا أعد لهم»

TAB-FULL:v22p288/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r8.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r8.claim: Ibn Zayd describes a person whose desire subdues knowledge until knowledge becomes weak and contemptible, placing this type among the people of Hell.
TAB-FULL:v22p288/r8.anchor: سمعت ابن زيد، يقول: " وجدت الهوى ثلاثة أثلاث، فالمرء يجعل هواه علمه، فيديل هواه على علمه

TAB-FULL:v22p289/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r1.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r1.claim: Ibn Zayd says two groups enter Paradise: those whose knowledge prevails over desire and those who end life with knowledge dominant; the group whose desire overcomes knowledge is in Hell.
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r1.anchor: قال: فزوجان في الجنة، وزوج في النار قال: والسابق الذي يكون العلم غالبا للهوى، والآخر: الذي ختم الله بإدالة العلم على الهوى

TAB-FULL:v22p289/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r5.speaker: ابن سيرين
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r5.claim: Ibn Sīrīn identifies the foremost as those who prayed toward both qiblas.
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r5.anchor: عن ابن سيرين، {والسابقون السابقون} [الواقعة: 10] الذين صلوا للقبلتين

TAB-FULL:v22p289/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r6.speaker: عثمان بن أبي سودة
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r6.claim: ʿUthmān ibn Abī Sawda identifies the foremost as the earliest to go to mosques and quickest to set out in God’s path.
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r6.anchor: ثنا عثمان بن أبي سودة قال: {والسابقون السابقون} [الواقعة: 10] «أولهم رواحا

TAB-FULL:v22p289/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r7.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r7.claim: The first “foremost” can be raised by its repetition, yielding “the foremost first ones,” or by “those are the brought-near”; the latter means God brings them near in Paradise.
TAB-FULL:v22p289/r7.anchor: والرفع في السابقين من وجهين: أحدهما: أن يكون الأول مرفوعا بالثاني، ويكون معنى الكلام حينئذ والسابقون الأولون

BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r10.claim: The Forerunners are the third of the three classes; they are mentioned last so their excellent state can be described next.
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r10.anchor: هم القسم الثالث من الأزواج الثلاثة آخر ذكرهم ليقترن ببيان محاسن أحوالهم

BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r11.claim: Sabq originally means moving ahead while travelling, then it is extended to precedence in other matters.
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r11.anchor: وأصل السبق التقدم في السير ثم نجوز به في غيره من التقدم

BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r12.claim: The phrase can be a subject and predicate meaning that their state and virtues are renowned; the cited comparison similarly repeats a predicate for emphasis.
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r12.anchor: والجملة مبتدأ وخبر والمعنى والسابقون هم الذين اشتهرت أحوالهم وعرفت محاسنهم كقوله أنا أبو النجم وشعري شعري

BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r13.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r13.claim: Alternatively, the second السابقون emphatically repeats the first, magnifying the Forerunners; the predicate follows in أولئك.
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r13.anchor: والثاني تأكيد له كرر تعظيما لهم والخبر جملة قوله أولئك

BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r14.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r14.claim: Some infer the omitted question ما السابقون from the preceding ما أصحاب الميمنة and ما أصحاب المشأمة.
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r14.anchor: وفي البرهان التقدير عند بعضهم السابقون ما السابقون فحذف ما لدلالة ما قبله عليه

BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r15.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r15.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r15.claim: One view defines them as the first to believe and obey when truth appeared, without hesitation or delay, making their precedence chronological.
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r15.anchor: وهم الذين سبقوا إلى الإيمان والطاعة عند ظهور الحق من غير تلعثم وتوان فالمراد بالسبق هو السبق بالزمان

BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r16.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r16.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r16.claim: Another view defines them by attaining religious perfections and virtues, so their precedence is rank rather than time.
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r16.anchor: أو الذين سبقوا في حيازة الكمالات الدينية والفضائل القينية فالمراد بالسبق هو السبق بالشرف

BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r17.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r17.speaker: الراغب
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r17.claim: Al-Raghib says السبق is borrowed for attaining excellence; the Forerunners thus reach God’s reward and Garden through righteous deeds.
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r17.anchor: ما قال الراغب يستعار السبق لإحراز الفضل وعلى ذلك والسابقون السابقون أي المقتدمون إلى ثواب الله

TABATABAI:56:1/r14.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:1/r14.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:1/r14.claim: The first occurrence refers to those foremost in good deeds, as in the verse classifying people by their deeds and God's leave.
TABATABAI:56:1/r14.anchor: الذي يصلح أن يفسر به السابقون الأول قوله تعالى

TABATABAI:56:10/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:10/r1.claim: Those foremost in good works also precede others toward the forgiveness and mercy corresponding to those works.
TABATABAI:56:10/r1.anchor: وإذا سبقوا بالخيرات سبقوا إلى المغفرة والرحمة التي بإزائها

TABATABAI:56:10/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:10/r2.claim: The repeated expression can be parsed as a subject followed by its predicate.

TABATABAI:56:10/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r3.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r3.claim: Another parse makes the first السابقون the subject, the second an emphatic repetition, and “those are the brought-near” the predicate.

TABATABAI:56:10/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r4.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r4.claim: A reported reading treats the second word as a restatement of the first, like the quoted Arabic saying about Abu al-Najm and his poetry.
TABATABAI:56:10/r4.anchor: وقيل المراد بالسابقون الثاني هو الأول على حد قوله

TABATABAI:56:10/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r5.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r5.claim: One reported view identifies them as people who hasten to everything God calls them to do.
TABATABAI:56:10/r5.anchor: فقيل هم المسارعون إلى كل ما دعا الله إليه

TABATABAI:56:10/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r6.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r6.claim: Another view identifies them as those who enter faith and obedience without delay.
TABATABAI:56:10/r6.anchor: وقيل هم الذين سبقوا إلى الإيمان والطاعة من غير توان

TABATABAI:56:10/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r7.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r7.claim: A further view takes them to be the prophets, who preceded the followers of their religions.
TABATABAI:56:10/r7.anchor: وقيل هم الأنبياء عليهم السلام لأنهم مقدموا أهل الأديان

TABATABAI:56:10/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r8.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r8.claim: Another view names the believer from Pharaoh's family, Habib al-Najjar, and Ali, first to believe in the Prophet and the best of them.
TABATABAI:56:10/r8.anchor: وقيل هم مؤمن آل فرعون وحبيب النجار المذكور في سورة يس

TABATABAI:56:10/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r9.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r9.claim: Other reported identifications are those who preceded in the Hijra.

TABATABAI:56:10/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r10.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r10.claim: Another reported identification is those who preceded others in the five daily prayers.
TABATABAI:56:10/r10.anchor: وقيل هم السابقون إلى الصلوات الخمس

TABATABAI:56:10/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r11.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r11.claim: Another view identifies them as those who prayed toward both qiblas.
TABATABAI:56:10/r11.anchor: وقيل هم الذين صلوا إلى القبلتين

TABATABAI:56:10/r12.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r12.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r12.claim: Another reported identification is those who were first to jihad.

TABATABAI:56:10/r13.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r13.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:10/r13.claim: The first two additional explanations fit the earlier general sense; prophets and named exemplars should be understood illustratively, as may the remaining identifications.
TABATABAI:56:10/r13.anchor: والقولان الأولان راجعان إلى ما تقدم من المعنى

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r1.speaker: القمي
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r1.claim: Al-Qummi glosses the three classes and calls the foremost those who preceded to Paradise; Tabataba'i says this explains the second occurrence of السابقون.
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r1.anchor: وقوله { وكنتم أزواجا ثلاثة } قال يوم القيامة

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas reports that the verse was revealed about Hizqil, the believer from Pharaoh's family, Habib al-Najjar, and Ali; each led his people, and Ali was foremost.
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r3.anchor: أخرج ابن مردويه عن ابن عباس في قوله

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r4.speaker: أبو جعفر
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r4.claim: Abu Ja'far names four forerunners: Adam's murdered son, Pharaoh's believer, Habib from Jesus's community, and Ali for Muhammad's community; al-Sadiq is also reported with this account.
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r4.anchor: وفي المجمع عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال السابقون أربعة ابن آدم المقتول

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r5.speaker: رسول الله
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r5.claim: In a report from Ibn Abbas, the Prophet says Gabriel identified the verse with Ali and his Shi'a, who precede to Paradise and are brought near through God's honor.
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r5.anchor: بإسناده إلى ابن عباس قال سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r6.speaker: أبو جعفر
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r6.claim: Abu Ja'far says, “We are the foremost, and we are the last ones.”
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r6.anchor: وفي كمال الدين بإسناده إلى خيثمة الجعفي عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام في حديث

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r7.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r7.claim: A report in al-Uyun transmitted from Ali says that “the foremost, the foremost; those are the brought-near” was revealed concerning him.
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r7.anchor: وفي العيون في باب ما جاء عن الرضا عليه السلام من الأخبار المجموعة بإسناده عن علي عليه السلام قال

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r8.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r8.claim: Al-Majma' reports an interpretation from Ali that the foremost are those who preceded to the five daily prayers.
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r8.anchor: وفي المجمع في الآية وقيل إلى الصلوات الخمس

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r9.claim: Tabataba'i says these reports should all be read as illustrative instances of the general meaning.
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r9.anchor: أقول الوجه حمل جميع هذه الأخبار على التمثيل كما تقدم

TABRISI:56:2-10/r23.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:2-10/r23.speaker: الجبائي
TABRISI:56:2-10/r23.claim: Al-Jubbaʾi identifies forerunners as those who raced to follow the prophets, became leaders of guidance, and raced to abundant reward.
TABRISI:56:2-10/r23.anchor: فهم السابقون إلى جزيل الثواب عند الله عن الجبائي.

TABRISI:56:11-16/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:56:11-16/r1.claim: The forerunners race to obey God and reach His mercy; they deserve distinction because they model good, attain the highest rank first, and precede later followers.
TABRISI:56:11-16/r1.anchor: وقيل: معناه السابقون إلى طاعة الله وهم السابقون إلى رحمته والسابق إلى الخير

TABRISI:56:11-16/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:56:11-16/r2.claim: The second occurrence of al-sābiqūn can predicate the first, or be emphatic repetition with an omitted predicate.
TABRISI:56:11-16/r2.anchor: فعلى هذا يكون السابقون الثاني خبرا عن الأول ويجوز أن يكون الثاني تأكيدا للأول

TABRISI:56:11-16/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r5.speaker: مقاتل
TABRISI:56:11-16/r5.claim: Muqatil and ʿIkrima identify the forerunners as those who raced to faith.
TABRISI:56:11-16/r5.anchor: وقد قيل في السابقين أنهم السابقون إلى الإيمان عن مقاتل وعكرمة

TABRISI:56:11-16/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
TABRISI:56:11-16/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies the forerunners as those who raced to emigrate.
TABRISI:56:11-16/r6.anchor: وقيل: السابقون إلى الهجرة عن ابن عباس

TABRISI:56:11-16/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r7.speaker: علي
TABRISI:56:11-16/r7.claim: Ali identifies them as those who raced to the five daily prayers.
TABRISI:56:11-16/r7.anchor: وقيل: إلى الصلوات الخمس عن علي ع

TABRISI:56:11-16/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r8.speaker: الضحاك
TABRISI:56:11-16/r8.claim: Al-Dahhak identifies them as those who raced to jihad.

TABRISI:56:11-16/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r9.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
TABRISI:56:11-16/r9.claim: Saʿid ibn Jubayr identifies them as those who raced to repentance and righteous deeds.
TABRISI:56:11-16/r9.anchor: وقيل: إلى التوبة وأعمال البر عن سعيد بن جبير

TABRISI:56:11-16/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r10.speaker: ابن كيسان
TABRISI:56:11-16/r10.claim: Ibn Kaysan says they raced to everything God called them to; the author prefers this comprehensive interpretation.
TABRISI:56:11-16/r10.anchor: وقيل: إلى كل ما دعا الله إليه عن ابن كيسان وهذا أولى لأنه يعم الجميع

TABRISI:56:11-16/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r11.speaker: عروة بن الزبير
TABRISI:56:11-16/r11.claim: ʿUrwa ibn al-Zubayr used to urge people, 'Advance, advance.'
TABRISI:56:11-16/r11.anchor: وكان عروة بن الزبير يقول تقدموا تقدموا

TABRISI:56:11-16/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r12.speaker: أبو جعفر
TABRISI:56:11-16/r12.claim: Abu Jaʿfar names four forerunners: Adam's slain son, the believer from Pharaoh's people, Habib al-Najjar among Jesus' people, and Ali ibn Abi Talib among Muhammad's people.
TABRISI:56:11-16/r12.anchor: وعن أبي جعفر ع قال: السابقون أربعة ابن آدم المقتول وسابق في أمة موسى

THALABI:v9p202/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r1.speaker: كعب
THALABI:v9p202/r1.claim: Kaʿb says the foremost are the people of the Qurʾān, who will be crowned on Resurrection Day.
THALABI:v9p202/r1.anchor: عن كعب في قول الله عز وجل: والسابقون السابقون أولئك المقربون في جنات النعيم قال: هم أهل القرآن

THALABI:v9p202/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r2.speaker: عثمان بن أبي سودة
THALABI:v9p202/r2.claim: ʿUthmān ibn Abī Sawda says the foremost are those who arrive earliest at the mosque and are first to go out in God's cause.
THALABI:v9p202/r2.anchor: عثمان بن أبي سودة يقول: السابقون أولهم رواحا إلى المسجد وأولهم خروجا في سبيل الله

THALABI:v9p202/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r3.speaker: عبد الله بن شميط
THALABI:v9p202/r3.claim: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Shumayṭ describes three trajectories: one who starts good young and persists is foremost; one who repents after a sinful youth is among the right; one who persists in youthful evil is among the left.
THALABI:v9p202/r3.anchor: عبد الله بن شميط قال: سمعت أبي يقول: الناس ثلاثة: فرجل ابتكر الخير في حداثة سنه ثم داوم عليه

THALABI:v9p202/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
THALABI:v9p202/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says those who were foremost in migration are foremost in the afterlife.
THALABI:v9p202/r4.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: السابقون إلى الهجرة هم السابقون في الآخرة

THALABI:v9p202/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r5.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
THALABI:v9p202/r5.claim: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib says they are foremost in performing the five prayers.
THALABI:v9p202/r5.anchor: وقال علي بن أبي طالب: إلى الصلوات الخمس

THALABI:v9p202/r6.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r6.speaker: عكرمة
THALABI:v9p202/r6.claim: ʿIkrima says they are foremost in Islam.

THALABI:v9p202/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r7.speaker: الضحاك
THALABI:v9p202/r7.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says they are foremost in jihad.

THALABI:v9p202/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r8.speaker: القرظي
THALABI:v9p202/r8.claim: Al-Quraẓī says they are foremost in every good deed.

THALABI:v9p202/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r9.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
THALABI:v9p202/r9.claim: Saʿīd ibn Jubayr says they are those who hasten to repentance and righteous deeds, as in commands to race toward forgiveness.
THALABI:v9p202/r9.anchor: سعيد بن جبير: هم المسارعون إلى التوبة وإلى أعمال البر. نظيره وسارعوا إلى مغفرة من ربكم سابقوا إلى مغفرة من ربكم

THALABI:v9p202/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r10.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p202/r10.claim: The author praises the foremost with another verse saying they hasten in good works and are ahead in them.
THALABI:v9p202/r10.anchor: ثم أثنى عليهم فقال عز من قائل أولئك يسارعون في الخيرات وهم لها سابقون

THALABI:v9p202/r11.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r11.speaker: الربيع عن أنس
THALABI:v9p202/r11.claim: Al-Rabīʿ transmits from Anas that they were foremost in responding to the Messenger in this life and will be foremost into Paradise in the next.
THALABI:v9p202/r11.anchor: الربيع عن أنس: السابقون إلى إجابة الرسول في الدنيا، وهم السابقون إلى الجنة في العقبى

THALABI:v9p202/r12.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r12.speaker: ابن كيسان
THALABI:v9p202/r12.claim: Ibn Kaysān says they are foremost in everything to which God calls people.
THALABI:v9p202/r12.anchor: ابن كيسان: السابقون إلى كل ما دعا الله سبحانه وتعالى إليه

THALABI:v9p202/r14.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r14.speaker: عروة بن الزبير
THALABI:v9p202/r14.claim: ʿUrwa ibn al-Zubayr reports that people used to urge one another, “Go ahead, go ahead.”
THALABI:v9p202/r14.anchor: عن عروة بن الزبير قال: كان يقال : تقدموا تقدموا

THALABI:v9p203/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p203/r1.speaker: رجل من أهل الكوفة
THALABI:v9p203/r1.claim: A Kufan informant says that when one of the foremost, brought-near residents leaves his Paradise dwelling, his light identifies him to those below.
THALABI:v9p203/r1.anchor: بلغني أنه إذا خرج رجل من السابقين المقربين من مسكنه في الجنة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies them as those who preceded others in affirming God’s oneness and believing His Messenger, as in 9:100.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r2.anchor: فقال ابن عباس (¬1): يريد الذين سبقوا إلى توحيد الله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r3.speaker: ابن سيرين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r3.claim: Ibn Sīrīn identifies them as those who prayed toward both qiblas, an early group of the Companions and thus close to Ibn ʿAbbās’s view.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r3.anchor: وقال ابن سيرين: هم الذين صلوا القبلتين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r4.speaker: عكرمة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r4.claim: ʿIkrima says they were the first to accept Islam.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r4.anchor: ونحو هذا قال عكرمة: السابقون إلى الإسلام

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r5.speaker: الربيع
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r5.claim: Al-Rabīʿ describes them as the first to answer the Messenger.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r5.anchor: وهو معنى قول الربيع: إلى إجابة الرسول

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r6.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r6.claim: Muqātil says they were first to believe in the prophets, restricting them to the earliest of this community.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r7.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r7.claim: Al-Kalbī says the first to follow the Messenger in each community will be first to Paradise in the afterlife.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r7.anchor: وقال الكلبي: السابقون إلى الرسول من كل أمة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r8.speaker: أكثر المفسرين
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r8.claim: Most exegetes understand precedence as precedence in obedience; al-Quraẓī broadly includes every good and all God’s invitations, the choice of Ibn Kaysān.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r8.anchor: وأكثر المفسرين جعلوا هذا السبق إلى الطاعات، فمنهم من أجملها

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r9.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r9.claim: Saʿīd b. Jubayr specifies repentance as the act in which they were foremost.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r9.anchor: فقال سعيد بن جبير: إلى التوبة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r10.speaker: علي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r10.claim: ʿAlī specifies the five daily prayers.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r10.anchor: وقال علي -رضي الله عنه-: إلى الصلوات الخمس

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r11.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r11.speaker: عثمان بن أبي سودة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r11.claim: ʿUthmān b. Abī Sawda specifies going early to the mosque and jihad, in the first ranks of worshippers and fighters.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r11.anchor: وقال عثمان بن أبي سودة (¬2): إلى المسجد، إلى الجهاد

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:1-10/r12.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:1-10/r12.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:1-10/r12.claim: The forerunners are those first to believe in every community and first to attain God’s mercy and Garden.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:1-10/r12.anchor: { والسابقون } إلى الإيمان، من كل أمة { السابقون } إلى رحمة الله وجنته.

QASHANI:56:10-14/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:56:10-14/r1.speaker: author
QASHANI:56:10-14/r1.claim: The foremost are monotheists who outstrip both groups and pass beyond both worlds through annihilation in God.
QASHANI:56:10-14/r1.anchor: الموحدون الذين سبقوا الفريقين وجاوزوا العالمين بالفناء في الله

QASHANI:56:10-14/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:56:10-14/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:56:10-14/r2.claim: Repeating 'the foremost' signals that no further praise or description can encompass them.
QASHANI:56:10-14/r2.anchor: الذين لا يمكن مدحهم والزيادة على أوصافهم

ELMALILI:56:1-24/r21.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r21.speaker: author
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r21.claim: The foremost are those who lead in worship, faith, obedience, and good works; examples include prophets, the Yasin companion, Pharaoh’s believing relative, and the earliest Companions among the emigrants and Helpers.
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r21.anchor: Hakk’a kullukta iman ve tâatte hayır yarışlarında en öne geçenlerdir.

ELMALILI:56:1-24/r22.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r22.speaker: author
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r22.claim: The repeated term is subject and predicate: the true fore-runners bear the title in reality and reach the destination before the other two classes.
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r22.anchor: unvânını hâiz olanlar hakikaten sâbikūn vasfını hâiz olan

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:1/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:1/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:1/r3.claim: The foremost are the muqarrabun, those nearest to God: the leading, higher-ranking portion of those whose record is given on the right.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:1/r3.anchor: bunların, amel defteri sağından verilenlerin önde gelen, mertebesi yüksek olan kesimi oldukları anlaşılmaktadır

QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r18.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r18.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r18.claim: The forerunners form the third group and lead in praiseworthy qualities and acts of excellence.
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r18.anchor: وهم الصف الثالث . وهم السابقون إلى الخصال الحميدة ، والأفضال الجميلة

QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r19.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r19.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r19.claim: Other views say they were first in emigration, Islam, the five prayers, sincerity, high aspiration, or every good deed.
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r19.anchor: ويقال : السابقون إلى الهجرة . ويقال : إلى الإسلام . ويقال : إلى الصلوات الخمس

QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r20.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r20.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r20.claim: One view calls forerunners those who hasten to repent and regret their sins.
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r20.anchor: المتسارعون إلى التوبة من الذنوب فيتسارعون إلى الندم

QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r21.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r21.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r21.claim: Another view identifies them as those whom God promised the highest reward and who hastened to the good allotted to them.
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r21.anchor: الذين سبقت لهم من الله الحسنى فسبقوا إلى ما سبق إليه

ITQAN:v4p469/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p469/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v4p469/r5.claim: In the second category, an interpreter names an instance of a general class: the unjust neglect duties or commit prohibitions, the middle group performs duties and avoids prohibitions, and the foremost exceed in good deeds; these are examples, not exhaustive definitions.
ITQAN:v4p469/r5.anchor: مثاله ما نقل في قوله تعالى ﴿ ثم أورثنا الكتاب الذين اصطفينا ﴾ الآية فمعلوم أن الظالم لنفسه

ITQAN:v3p240#2/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p240#2/r2.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p240#2/r2.claim: People fall into three exhaustive moral groups: wrongdoers, those moderate in good, and those who race ahead; the three groups of 56:10 provide a parallel division.
ITQAN:v3p240#2/r2.anchor: فإن العالم لا يخلو من هذه الأقسام الثلاثة إما عاص ظالم لنفسه وإما سابق مبادر للخيرات

SULAMI:v2p299#4/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r1.speaker: author
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r1.claim: The forerunners are those granted divine friendship before they came into being; they are brought near in stations of intimacy.
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r1.anchor: هم الذين سبقت لهم من الله الولاية قبل كونهم هم المقربون أي في منازل القربة وروح الأنس

SULAMI:v2p299#4/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r2.speaker: author
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r2.claim: The prophets preceded others in faith in God, while the truthful and martyrs preceded others in faith in the prophets.
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r2.anchor: سبق الأنبياء إلى الإيمان بالله والصديقون والشهداء إلى الإيمان بالأنبياء

SULAMI:v2p299#4/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r3.speaker: الجريري
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r3.claim: The forerunners were brought near because they had no concern apart from God.
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r3.anchor: وقال الجريري في قوله : ^ ( والسابقون السابقون أولئك هم المقربون ) ^ قال : إنما قربوا إلى ربهم

SULAMI:v2p299#4/r4.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r4.speaker: الجريري
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r4.claim: The soul has three pairs: the spirit races through care, the heart through guarding, and the limbs through service; their gifts are modesty, purity, and recompense, respectively.
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r4.anchor: وقال : في النفس أزواج ثلاثة فإذا استقامت للسبق استقامت : الروح بالرعاية والقلب بالحراسة والجوارح بالخدمة

SULAMI:v2p299#4/r5.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r5.speaker: القاسم
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r5.claim: God attributes racing to servants, then says He brings them near; their action does not itself make them near, since if the act truly belonged to them, it would do so.
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r5.anchor: قال القاسم أضاف الله عز وجل الأفعال إلى عباده بقوله : ﴿ والسابقون السابقون ﴾ ثم قال : ﴿ أولئك المقربون ﴾

SULAMI:v2p299#4/r6.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r6.speaker: أبو علي الجوزجاني
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r6.claim: The forerunners are God’s knowers, brought near through gifts and honored by glad tidings; they know Him truly, worship sincerely, and are led by longing and love.
SULAMI:v2p299#4/r6.anchor: سمعت أبا علي الجوزجاني يقول : السابقون هم المقربون بالعطيات والمكرمون بالبشارات وهم العلماء بالله

TUSTARI:56:10/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:56:10/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:56:10/r1.claim: The foremost are those whom God chose and granted guardianship before their existence.
TUSTARI:56:10/r1.anchor: هم الذين سبق لهم من الله الاختيار والولاية قبل كونهم

DAMGHANI:v1p227/r9.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p227/r9.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p227/r9.claim: The foremost are those who race ahead to Paradise.
DAMGHANI:v1p227/r9.anchor: السادس : السبق إلى الجنة قوله تعالى في سورة الواقعة

FARRA:v3p121/r9.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p121/r9.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p121/r9.claim: One parse makes the second السابقون predicate/apposition and identifies the group as the Muhajirun and all who preceded a prophet.
FARRA:v3p121/r9.anchor: فإن شئت رفعت السابقين بالسابقين الثانية وهم المهاجرون، وكل من سبق إلى نبي

FARRA:v3p121/r10.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p121/r10.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p121/r10.claim: Alternatively, the second السابقون intensifies the first, and أولئك المقربون supplies the predicate.
FARRA:v3p121/r10.anchor: وإن شئت جعلت الثانية تشديدا للأولى، ورفعت بقوله: أولئك المقربون

NAHHAS:v4p323/r10.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p323/r10.speaker: محمد بن سيرين
NAHHAS:v4p323/r10.claim: Muhammad ibn Sirin identifies the forerunners as those who prayed toward both qiblas.
NAHHAS:v4p323/r10.anchor: قال محمد بن سيرين السابقون الذين صلوا القبلتين

NAHHAS:v4p323/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p323/r11.speaker: أبو إسحاق
NAHHAS:v4p323/r11.claim: Abu Ishaq parses the first forerunners as a subject and the second as its adjective, with those are the brought-near as predicate; alternatively the second is the predicate, meaning forerunners to God's mercy.
NAHHAS:v4p323/r11.anchor: أحدهما أن يكون السابقون الأول مرفوعا بالابتداء والثاني من صفته وخبر الابتداء أولئك المقربون ويجوز عنده أن يكون السابقون الأول مرفوعا بالابتداء

SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r1.speaker: سيبويه
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r1.claim: Sībawayh treats the words as subject and predicate, meaning the foremost are renowned foremost; repetition magnifies them, as in Abū al-Najm’s line.
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r1.anchor: وهذا يقال في تعظيم الأمر وتفخيمه، وهو مذهب سيبويه.

SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r2.speaker: أبو النجم
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r2.claim: Abū al-Najm’s أنا أبو النجم وشعري شعري exemplifies repetition used to glorify and magnify.

SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r3.claim: A second subject-predicate reading gives the instances different destinations: foremost in faith, obedience, or good works, and foremost to Paradise or mercy.
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r3.anchor: أن متعلق السبقتين مختلف، إذ التقدير: والسابقون إلى الإيمان السابقون إلى الجنة

SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r4.claim: Another analysis makes the second السابقون emphatic; أولئك المقربون is a new clause in the first clause’s predicate position, as in 7:26.
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r4.anchor: الوجه الثاني: أن يكون " السابقون " الثاني تأكيدا للأول تأكيدا لفظيا

SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r5.claim: The author rejects making the second السابقون an adjective of the first as pointless; an authority using that label likely meant emphasis called an adjective.
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r5.anchor: وهذا ينبغي أن لا يعرج عليه، كيف يوصف الشيء بلفظه وأي فائدة في ذلك؟

SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r6.claim: A final analysis pauses after the first word and starts a new clause; it requires strained coordination with أصحاب الميمنة and an insertion.
SAMIN-DURR:56:10/r6.anchor: وفي هذا الوجه تكلف كثير جدا

ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r1.claim: The forerunners are those who preceded in obedience to God and belief in His prophets.
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r1.anchor: معناه - والله أعلم - السابقون السابقون إلى طاعة الله عز وجل والتصديق بأنبيائه

ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r2.claim: One parsing makes the first السابقون a subject, the second an emphatic repetition, and أولئك المقربون the predicate.
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r2.anchor: والسابقون الأول رفع بالابتداء، والثاني توكيد، ويكون الخبر (أولئك المقربون)

ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r3.claim: Alternatively the first السابقون is the subject and the second its predicate: they preceded in obedience and in God's mercy, and those brought near describe them.
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r3.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون السابقون الأول رفعا بالابتداء. ويكون خبره (السابقون) الثاني

SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#9/r10.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#9/r10.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#9/r10.claim: Samarrāʾī identifies the foremost, brought-near ones as the highest of creation and contrasts their reward with that of the companions of the right.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#9/r10.anchor: في التفريق بين نعيم السابقين المقربين وهم أعلى الخلق ونعيم أصحاب اليمين

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p734/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p734/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p734/r2.claim: Al-Saffat describes other servants at a lower degree, while al-Waqiʿa describes the few forerunners at the highest ranks of Paradise.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p734/r2.anchor: وردت في عباد الله الآخِرين وهم أقلّ درجة من السابقين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p74/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p74/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p74/r13.claim: The sūra is Meccan and follows al-Raḥmān, which paired punishment for sinners with bliss for believers; its two pairs of gardens distinguish lower- and higher-ranking believers, matching the three groups named at this sūra’s start and the groups at its end.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p74/r13.anchor: هذه السورة مكية، ومناسبتها لما قبلها تضمن العذاب للمجرمين، والنعيم للمؤمنين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r1.claim: The two gardens below the first pair complete three human ranks: unbelievers, believers of lesser rank, and superior believers; the sūra opens with the three groups and ends with the companions of the right and deniers.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r1.anchor: فانقسم العالم بذلك إلى كافر ومؤمن مفضول ومؤمن فاضل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r10.claim: One parsing makes the first al-sābiqūn the subject and the second its predicate, explaining the repetition as an emphatic ‘they are the foremost’; the foremost excelled in acts of obedience.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r10.anchor: والسابقون السابقون: جوزوا أن يكون مبتدأ وخبرا، نحو قولهم: أنت أنت

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r11.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r11.claim: A second parsing treats the second al-sābiqūn as verbal emphasis, with the predicate in what follows.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r11.anchor: وأن يكون السابقون تأكيدا لفظيا، والخبر فيما بعد ذلك

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r12.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r12.claim: Another parsing makes the first al-sābiqūn the subject and the second its predicate, stopping after the repeated word.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r12.anchor: وأن يكون السابقون مبتدأ والخبر فيما بعده، وتقف على قوله: والسابقون

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r13.claim: A further analysis distinguishes those foremost in faith from those foremost in reaching Paradise; the second term can be a predicate or adjective, with the predicate after it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r13.anchor: وأن يكون متعلق السبق الأول مخالفا للسبق الثاني. والسابقون إلى الإيمان السابقون إلى الجنة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r14.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r14.claim: Abū Ḥayyān prefers Sibawayh’s first analysis: the repetition magnifies the foremost as the peak of greatness and happiness, and al-sābiqūn broadly includes those first in obedience and in avoiding sins.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r14.anchor: والوجه الأول، قال ابن عطية: ومذهب سيبويه أنه يعني السابقون خبر الابتداء

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r15.speaker: عثمان بن أبي سودة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r15.claim: ʿUthmān ibn Abī Sawda says the foremost are those who hasten to the mosques.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r15.anchor: وقال عثمان بن أبي سودة: السابقون إلى المساجد

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r16.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r16.speaker: ابن سيرين
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r16.claim: Ibn Sīrīn identifies them as those who prayed toward both qiblas.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r16.anchor: وقال ابن سيرين: هم الذين صلوا إلى القبلتين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r17.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r17.speaker: كعب
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r17.claim: Kaʿb says they are the people of the Qurʾān.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p79/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p79/r1.speaker: الحديث
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p79/r1.claim: A hadith defines the foremost as those who accept the truth when given it, give it when asked, and judge others as they judge themselves.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p79/r1.anchor: وفي الحديث: «سئل عن السابقين فقال هم الذين إذا أعطوا الحق قبلوه

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r1.claim: The forerunners are the third of the three groups; their mention is delayed despite their precedence in merit so their excellent states can follow, and the unqualified title does not assert precedence in every respect.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r1.anchor: هو الصنف الثالث من الأزواج الثلاثة ولعل تأخير ذكرهم مع كونهم أسبق الأصناف وأقدمهم في الفضل ليردف ذكرهم ببيان محاسن أحوالهم

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r2.speaker: عكرمة، مقاتل
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r2.claim: Ikrima and Muqatil say they are those who first believed and obeyed when truth appeared, without hesitation or delay.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r2.anchor: فقيل : هم الذين سبقوا إلى الإيمان والطاعة عند ظهور الحق

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r3.claim: A report from Ibn Abbas says the verse concerns Hizqil, the believer from Pharaoh’s people, Habib al-Najjar from Ya Sin, and Ali; each preceded his community and Ali was their best.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r3.anchor: وأخرج ابن مردويه عن ابن عباس

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r4.claim: Another view identifies them as those who first acquired certain knowledge and levels of piety beyond faith.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r4.anchor: حيازة الكمالات من العلوم اليقينية ومراتب التقوى الواقعة بعد الإيمان

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r5.claim: Another view identifies the forerunners as the prophets, who lead the adherents of their religions.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r5.anchor: وقيل هم الأنبياء عليهم السلام لأنهم مقدموا أهل الأديان

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r6.speaker: ابن سيرين
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r6.claim: Ibn Sirin says they are those who prayed toward both qiblas, linking the phrase to the earliest emigrants and Helpers.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r6.anchor: وقال ابن سيرين : هم الذين صلوا إلى القبلتين كما قال تعالى : ( والسابقون الأولون من المهاجرين والأنصار )

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas also identifies them as the first to migrate.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r7.anchor: وعن ابن عباس هم السابقون إلى الهجرة

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r8.speaker: علي
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r8.claim: Ali says they are those who were first to perform the five prayers.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r8.anchor: وعن علي كرم الله تعالى وجهه هم السابقون إلى الصلوات الخمس

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r9.speaker: رسول الله
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r9.claim: A report raised from Ibn Abbas says the forerunner is the first to set out for the mosque and the last to leave; no grading is stated.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r9.anchor: وأخرج أبو نعيم والديلمي عن ابن عباس مرفوعا أول من يهجر إلى المسجد وآخر من يخرج منه

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r10.speaker: عبادة بن أبي سودة
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r10.claim: Ubada ibn Abi Sawda says it reached them that the forerunners are those who arrive early at mosques and set out in God’s cause.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r10.anchor: عن عبادة بن أبي سودة مولى عبادة بن الصامت

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r11.speaker: الضحاك
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r11.claim: Al-Dahhak says they are those who are first to jihad.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r11.anchor: وعن الضحاك هم السابقون إلى الجهاد

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r12.speaker: ابن جبير
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r12.claim: Ibn Jubayr says they are first to repent and perform good works.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r12.anchor: وعن ابن جبير هم السابقون إلى التوبة وأعمال البر

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r13.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r13.speaker: كعب
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r13.claim: Ka‘b identifies them as the people of the Qur’an.

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r14.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r14.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r14.claim: A report in al-Bahr describes them as those who accept the truth when given, give when asked, and judge others as they judge themselves.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r14.anchor: وفي البحر في الحديث سئل عن السابقين فقال

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r15.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r15.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r15.claim: A three-person typology calls the lifelong doer of good a forerunner, the sinner who later repents a right-hand companion, and the lifelong evildoer a left-hand companion.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r15.anchor: وقيل : الناس ثلاثة فرجل ابتكر الخير في حداثة سنه ثم دام عليه

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r16.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r16.speaker: ابن كسيان
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r16.claim: Ibn Kaysan defines them generally as those who hasten to everything God calls them to.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r16.anchor: وعن ابن كسيان أنهم المسارعون إلى كل ما دعا الله تعالى إليه

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r17.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r17.speaker: بعضهم
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r17.claim: Some prefer Ibn Kaysan’s general definition and treat most of the other identifications as examples of it.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r17.anchor: ورجحه بعضهم بالعموم وجعل ما ذكر في أكثر الأقوال من باب التمثيل

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r18.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r18.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r18.claim: The common parsing makes the repeated phrase a topic and its predicate, meaning the forerunners are renowned and their greatness is well known.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132/r18.anchor: وأيا ما كان فالشائع أن الجملة مبتدأ وخبر والمعنى ( والسابقون ) هم الذين اشتهرت أحوالهم

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r1.claim: Repeating the noun as its own predicate magnifies the forerunners and signals their widely known merit, as illustrated by the quoted boast about Abu al-Najm’s poetry.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r1.anchor: أبو النجم وشعري شعري وفيه من تفخيم شأنهم والإيذان بشيوع فضلهم

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r2.speaker: صاحب المرشد
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r2.claim: An alternative gives the two occurrences different objects: first to God’s obedience and then to His mercy, or first to good and then to Paradise; the first formulation is attributed to Sahib al-Murshid.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r2.anchor: وقيل متعلق السبق مخالف لمتعلق السبق الثاني أي السابقون إلى طاعة الله تعالى

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r3.claim: The author prefers the ordinary predicate reading: it is complete without assigning different objects to each occurrence, and is more eloquent and fitting here.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#2/r3.anchor: وأنت تعلم أن الحمل مفيد بدون ذلك كما سمعت بل هو أبلغ وأنسب بالمقام

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r2.claim: A competing parse makes the first السابقون the topic, the repeated word its emphatic confirmation, and أولئك المقربون the predicate; the author rejects it as weakening the division, the rhetoric, and the following contrast.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r2.anchor: وقيل ( السابقون ) السابق مبتدأ ( والسابقون ) اللاحق تأكيد له وما بعد خبر

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r6.speaker: الإرشاد
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r6.claim: Al-Irshad takes each group label as the predicate of an omitted topic: the expected next step after dividing people is to name the categories, then describe them.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r6.anchor: الذي تقتضيه جزالة التنزيل أن قوله تعالى

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r7.speaker: الإرشاد
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r7.claim: On al-Irshad’s analysis, the descriptions of the first two groups are parenthetical previews of their eventual states, while the forerunners receive their description immediately and need no preview.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r7.anchor: خلا أنه لما أخر بيان أحوال القسمين الأولين عقب كلا منهما بجملة معترضة بين القسمين

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r8.speaker: الإرشاد
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r8.claim: Al-Irshad parses السابقون as a topic, with explicit repetition for grandeur; أولئك begins a second topic or is appositional, and المقربون supplies the predicate.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r8.anchor: فقوله تعالى : ( السابقون ) مبتدأ والإظهار في مقام الإضمار للتفخيم

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r9.claim: The author finds al-Irshad’s analysis more natural: after division, the categories themselves are expected as the primary point, rather than a judgment about them or their descriptions.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r9.anchor: والذي يتبادر للنظر الجليل ما في الإرشاد من كون أصحاب الميمنة وكذا كل من الأخيرين

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r10.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r10.claim: A criticism says al-Irshad’s parse does not itself give detailed states, but identifies the groups while alluding generally to their astonishing conditions; it also asks why the two questions about the other groups would be omitted from the detail.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r10.anchor: وقيل عليه : إنه ليس في جعل جملتي الاستفهام وقوله سبحانه : ( السابقون ) إخبارا لما قبلها

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r11.claim: A further analysis allows the two questions to modify their preceding group labels after an implied saying, and السابقون likewise to modify its antecedent; the following clause then resumes explanatorily.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r11.anchor: بل يجوز أن يكون كل منهما صفة لما قبلها بتقدير القول كأنه قيل : فأحدها أصحاب الميمنة

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r12.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r12.claim: Against the objection that this adjective analysis deletes a relative pronoun and part of its clause, the author denies that أل is relative when it does not indicate a new occurrence.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r12.anchor: وما يقال : إن في هذا الوجه حذف الموصول مع بعض أجزاء الصلة يجاب عنه بمنع كون أل في الوصف

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies the foremost as those first to emigrate, foremost in the afterlife.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r5.anchor: {والسابقون السابقون} قال ابن عباس: السابقون إلى الهجرة هم السابقون في الآخرة.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r6.speaker: عكرمة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r6.claim: ʿIkrima says the foremost are those first to accept Islam.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r7.speaker: ابن سيرين
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r7.claim: Ibn Sīrīn says they are those who prayed toward both qiblas, supported by 9:100.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r7.anchor: قال ابن سيرين: هم الذين صلوا إلى القبلتين

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r8.speaker: الربيع بن أنس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r8.claim: Al-Rabīʿ ibn Anas says those first to answer the Messenger in this life are first to Paradise in the next.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r8.anchor: قال الربيع بن أنس: السابقون إلى إجابة الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم في الدنيا هم السابقون إلى الجنة في العقبى.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r9.speaker: مقاتل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r9.claim: Muqātil identifies them as those first to answer the prophets with faith.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r10.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r10.claim: ʿAlī says they are foremost in the five daily prayers.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r10.anchor: وقال علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله تعالى عنه: إلى الصلوات الخمس.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r11.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r11.speaker: الضحاك
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r11.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says they are foremost in jihad.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r12.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r12.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r12.claim: Saʿīd ibn Jubayr says they hurry to repentance and good works, citing the calls to race toward forgiveness in 57:21 and 3:133.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r12.anchor: وقال سعيد بن جبير: هم المسارعون إلى التوبة وإلى أعمال البر

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r13.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r13.speaker: ابن كيسان
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r13.claim: Ibn Kaysān says they are foremost in everything God calls people to do.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r13.anchor: قال ابن كيسان: والسابقون إلى كل ما دعا الله إليه.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r14.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r14.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r14.claim: The author connects the description to those who hasten to good deeds and are foremost in them, a Qurʾānic phrase from 23:61.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r14.anchor: ثم أثنى عليهم فقال: أولئك يسارعون في الخيرات وهم لها سابقون

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r15.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r15.speaker: كعب
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r15.claim: Kaʿb says the foremost are Qurʾān reciters crowned on Judgment Day.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r15.anchor: وروي عن كعب قال: هم أهل القرآن المتوجون يوم القيامة.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r16.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r16.speaker: قيل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r16.claim: Another view identifies them as the first to arrive at the mosque and the first to go out in God's path.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r16.anchor: وقيل: هم أولهم رواحا إلى المسجد وأولهم خروجا في سبيل الله

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r17.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r17.speaker: القرظي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p8#3/r17.claim: Al-Quraẓī says they are first in every good deed.

BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r1.claim: The forerunners may be those who hastened to faith and obedience without hesitation, those who attained virtues first, the prophets, or those who reached Paradise first.
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r1.anchor: سبقوا إلى الإيمان والطاعة بعد ظهور الحق من غير تلعثم وتوان

BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r2.claim: Another view identifies them as those who were first to acquire virtues and perfections.

BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r3.claim: Another view identifies them as prophets, who lead the people of religions and whose state and outcome are known.

BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r4.claim: A further view identifies the forerunners as those who reached Paradise first.

BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r5.claim: The phrase presents their state and outcome as already known, like Abū al-Najm's self-announcing poetic line.
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r5.anchor: كقول أبي النجم: أنا أبو النجم وشعري شعري

BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r5.claim: After describing both sides, the author highlights the highest rank among the right-hand people to encourage excellence, while leaving the left undivided to warn of its end.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r5.anchor: ذكر أعلى أهل القسم الأول ترغيبا في أحسن حالهم ولم يقسم أهل المشأمة ترهيبا

BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r6.claim: The forerunners race to obedience; they belong to the first two gardens mentioned in al-Raḥmān and are the people of the heart, uniquely deserving the higher station.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r6.anchor: إلى أعمال الطاعة أصحاب الجنتين الأوليين في الرحمن وهم أصحاب القلب

BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r7.speaker: المهدوي
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r7.claim: Al-Mahdawī attributes to the Prophet a description of forerunners as those who accept a right when given, give when asked, and judge others as themselves.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r7.anchor: وعن المهدوي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال

DURR-FULL:v8p5/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p5/r7.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p5/r7.claim: Qatada says the three classes are Judgment Day stations; the repeated questions ask what awaits the right- and left-hand groups, and the forerunners are foremost from every nation.
DURR-FULL:v8p5/r7.anchor: عن قتادة {وكنتم أزواجا ثلاثة} قال: منازل الناس يوم القيامة {فأصحاب الميمنة ما أصحاب الميمنة}

DURR-FULL:v8p5/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p5/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p5/r9.claim: Ibn Abbas names Joshua son of Nun as preceding Moses, the believer of Yasin as preceding Jesus, and Ali as preceding the Prophet; each preceded his own people.
DURR-FULL:v8p5/r9.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما في قوله: {والسابقون السابقون} قال: يوشع بن نون سبق إلى موسى ومؤمن آل يس

DURR-FULL:v8p5/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p5/r10.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p5/r10.claim: The Prophet says he is foremost among Arabs, Salman among Persians, Bilal among Abyssinians, and Suhayb among Romans.
DURR-FULL:v8p5/r10.anchor: عن الحسن قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: السابقون يوم القيامة أربعة فأنا سابق العرب وسلمان سابق فارس

DURR-FULL:v8p6/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas transmits the Prophet’s saying that the foremost enter the mosque first and leave it last.
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: {والسابقون السابقون أولئك المقربون} أول من يدخل المسجد

DURR-FULL:v8p6/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r2.speaker: عثمان بن أبي سودة
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r2.claim: Uthman ibn Abi Sawda says the foremost go early to mosques and set out in God’s cause.
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r2.anchor: عن عثمان بن أبي سودة مولى عبادة بن الصامت قال: بلغنا في هذه الآية {والسابقون السابقون} أنهم السابقون إلى المساجد

DURR-FULL:v8p6/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas explains that the foremost come from every community.
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس {والسابقون السابقون} قال: من كل أمة

DURR-FULL:v8p6/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r4.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r4.claim: Qatada likewise says the foremost come from every community.
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r4.anchor: عبد بن حميد عن قتادة مثله

DURR-FULL:v8p6/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas says the verse concerns Hezekiel, the believer from Pharaoh’s people, Habib al-Najjar, and Ali; each preceded his community, and Ali was foremost.
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r5.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {والسابقون السابقون} قال: نزلت في حزقيل مؤمن آل فرعون وحبيب النجار

DURR-FULL:v8p6/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r6.claim: Al-Numan ibn Bashir reports that people are paired with those whose deeds resemble theirs, as shown by the three classes.
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r6.anchor: عن النعمان بن بشير قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: {وإذا النفوس زوجت} قال: الضرباء كل رجل مع قوم

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3329#6/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3329#6/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3329#6/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās names Joshua son of Nun as first to Moses, the believer of the family of Yā Sīn as first to Jesus, and ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib as first to the Messenger.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3329#6/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما في قوله : والسابقون السابقون قال : يوشع بن نون سبق إلى موسى

IBNABIHATIM:v10p3329#6/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3329#6/r2.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3329#6/r2.claim: Al-Nuʿmān ibn Bashīr reports the Prophet’s explanation that people are paired with those who shared their deeds; he identifies the forerunners as these counterparts.
IBNABIHATIM:v10p3329#6/r2.anchor: عن النعمان بن بشير قال : قال رسول الله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r1.claim: The foremost are the third and best of the three classes, ahead of the good-doers described as the people of the right; they hasten toward the most prized good.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r1.anchor: وقوله : { والسابقون } هذا الصنف الثالث في العد وهم الصنف الأفضل من الأصناف الثلاثة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r2.claim: People race for what is precious and desired by all, while they shrink from evil and harm; hence the foremost are early in seeking good.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r2.anchor: فالناس لا يتسابقون إلا لنوال نفيس مرغوب لكل الناس ، وأما الشر والضر فهم يتكعكون عنه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r3.claim: The literal sense is reaching a place before another person; here it is metaphorical, as the cited line by al-Nabigha blends literal racing with precedence in rank.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r3.anchor: وحقيقة السبق : وصول أحد مكانا قبل وصول أحد آخر . وهو هنا مستعمل على سبيل الاستعارة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r4.speaker: النابغة
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r4.claim: Al-Nabigha's line compares men who precede others in honor to a swift horse reaching the hunt before other mounts.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r4.anchor: وقد جمع المعنيين قول النابغة : سبقت الرجال الباهشين إلى العلا كسبق الجواد اصطاد قبل الظوارد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r5.claim: One possibility is that the foremost initiate and hasten toward good in religion, like the first emigrants and Helpers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r5.anchor: فيجوز أن يكون { السابقون } مستعملا في المبادرة والإسراع إلى الخير في الدين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r6.claim: Another possibility is that they compete to attain good, as in the description of people who hasten to good deeds and are foremost in them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r6.anchor: مستعملا في المغالبة في تحصيل الخير كقوله تعالى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r7.claim: The second occurrence of al-sabiqun may be the predicate of the first, like the repeated question about the people of the right, asserting an excellence beyond ordinary description.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r7.anchor: وقوله : السابقون } ثانيا يجوز جعله خبرا عن { السابقون } الأول كما أخبر عن أصحاب الميمنة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r8.claim: Alternatively, the second al-sabiqun is emphasis of the first; both readings express amazement, but one asks about their quality and the other repeats the only adequate description.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r8.anchor: ويجوز جعله تأكيدا للأول فمآل جملة { ما أصحاب الميمنة } ونظيرتها وجملة { والسابقون السابقون } هو التعجيب من حالهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r9.claim: Their rank is so excellent that no predicate expresses it better than foremost; this conveys their honor more forcefully than the exclamatory formulation for the people of the right.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p286#2/r9.anchor: أن حالهم بلغت منتهى الفضل والرفعة بحيث لا يجد المتكلم خبرا يخبر به عنهم أدل على مرتبتهم من اسم { السابقون }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r1.claim: The title’s derivation from السبق signals that these people attain the utmost goal sought by aspirants.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r1.anchor: مع ما في اشتقاق لقبهم من ( السبق ) من الدلالة على بلوغهم أقصى ما يطلبه الطالبون .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r2.claim: Omitting what they are foremost in turns the descriptor into their epithet and generalizes it to every field of virtuous competition.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r2.anchor: وحذف متعلق { السابقون } في الآية لقصد جعل وصف { السابقون } بمنزلة اللقب لهم ، وليفيد العموم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r3.claim: They are the earliest believers in messengers, companions who received their laws; this class spans all eras through the Muhammadan community rather than ending before it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r3.anchor: فهؤلاء هم السابقون إلى الإيمان بالرسل وهم الذين صحبوا الرسل والأنبياء وتلقوا منهم شرائعهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r4.claim: Mentioning the foremost after the companions of the right stirs curiosity and encourages emulation after the other two classes have been introduced.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r4.anchor: وأخر { السابقون } في الذكر عن أصحاب اليمين لتشويق السامعين إلى معرفة صنفهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r6.claim: The passage begins detailing the recompense of the three classes through a نشر بعد اللف arrangement, deliberately disordered by proximity of meanings and then relative priority.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r6.anchor: ابتداء تفصيل لجزاء الأصناف الثلاثة على طريقة النشر بعد اللف ، نشرا مشوشا تشويشا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p101/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p101/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p101/r1.claim: Qur’anic inimitability has long occupied rhetoricians. Rhetoric studies Arabic eloquence as a critical and compositional standard, then shows the Qur’an uniquely combines qualities beyond the reach of earlier and later eloquent speakers.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p101/r1.anchor: ثم ليظهر من جراء ذلك كيف تفوق القرآن على كل كلام بليغ بما توفر فيه من الخصائص التي لا تجتمع في كلام آخر للبلغاء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p101/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p101/r2.speaker: أبو يعقوب السكاكي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p101/r2.claim: Al-Sakkaki says that rhetorical rules demonstrate mastery to their readers and, when applied by someone with taste to God’s speech, reveal the Qur’an’s inimitability.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p101/r2.anchor: قال أبو يعقوب السكاكي في كتاب المفتاح واعلم أني مهدت لك في هذا العلم قواعد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r1.speaker: بعض النحويين
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r1.claim: Some grammarians treat the second السابقون as an adjective of the first.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r1.anchor: قال بعض النحويين: هو نعت للأول، ومذهب سيبويه أنه خبر الابتداء

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r2.speaker: سيبويه
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r2.claim: Sībawayh makes the second السابقون the clause's predicate.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r2.anchor: ومذهب سيبويه أنه خبر الابتداء، وهذا كما تقول العرب: الناس الناس، وأنت أنت

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r3.claim: The repetition magnifies the matter; it can also mean those foremost in faith, Paradise, and mercy, with either syntax.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r3.anchor: وهذا على معنى تفخيم أمر وتعظيمه، ومعنى الصفة هو أن تقول: والسابقون إلى الإيمان السابقون إلى الجنة والرحمة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r10.claim: Generally, the foremost were granted felicity beforehand and led in worldly good works and avoidance of sins.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r10.anchor: و: السابقون معناه: قد سبقت لهم السعادة، وكانت أعمالهم في الدنيا سبقا إلى أعمال البر وإلى ترك المعاصي، فهذا عموم في جميع الناس

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r11.speaker: عثمان بن أبي سودة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r11.claim: ʿUthmān ibn Abī Sawda narrows the foremost to those who arrive first at mosques.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r11.anchor: وخصص المفسرون في هذا أشياء، فقال عثمان بن أبي سودة: هم السابقون إلى المساجد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r12.speaker: ابن سيرين
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r12.claim: Ibn Sīrīn identifies them as those who prayed facing both qiblas.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r12.anchor: وقال ابن سيرين: هم الذين صلوا القبلتين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r13.speaker: كعب
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r13.claim: Kaʿb identifies them as the people of the Qur'an.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r13.anchor: وقال كعب: هم أهل القرآن، وقيل غير هذا مما هو جزء من الأعمال الصالحة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r14.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r14.claim: The Prophet says they accept a right when given, give when asked, and judge others as themselves.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r14.anchor: وروي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وسئل عن السابقين، فقال: «هم الذين إذا أعطوا الحق قبلوه، وإذا سئلوا بذلوه، وحكموا للناس بحكمهم لأنفسهم»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r17.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r17.speaker: عامر بن عبد قيس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r17.claim: When asked who won a race, ʿĀmir ibn ʿAbd Qays answered: those brought near to God.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r17.anchor: وقيل لعامر بن عبد قيس في يوم حلبة من سبق فقال المقربون

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r1.speaker: الحسن وقتادة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r1.claim: One view identifies the foremost as those who were first to believe in every community.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r1.anchor: أحدها أنهم السابقون إلى الإيمان من كل أمة قاله الحسن وقتادة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r2.speaker: ابن سيرين
