IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r2.claim: Ibn Sīrīn says they are those who prayed toward both qiblas.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r2.anchor: والثاني أنهم الذين صلوا إلى القبلتين قاله ابن سيرين

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r3.speaker: كعب
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r3.claim: Kaʿb identifies them as the people of the Qur’an.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r4.speaker: محمد بن كعب
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r4.claim: Muḥammad ibn Kaʿb says they are the prophets.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r4.anchor: والرابع الأنبياء قاله محمد بن كعب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r5.speaker: عثمان بن أبي سودة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r5.claim: ʿUthmān ibn Abī Sawda identifies them as those who hasten to mosques and to set out in God’s path.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r5.anchor: والخامس السابقون إلى المساجد وإلى الخروج في سبيل الله قاله عثمان بن أبي سودة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r6.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r6.claim: Al-Zajjāj gives two explanations for repeating ‘the foremost’: emphasis, or that those foremost in obedience are foremost in God’s mercy.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r6.anchor: وفي إعادة ذكرهم قولان أحدهما أن ذلك للتوكيد والثاني أن المعنى السابقون إلى طاعة الله

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r1.claim: People divide into three groups: those on the right of the Throne, from Adam’s right side, receiving books in their right hands and led right; those on the left, from Adam’s left, receiving books in their left hands and led left; and the foremost, a smaller, more elite and nearer group including messengers, prophets, the truthful, and martyrs.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r1.anchor: وقوله: {وكنتم أزواجا ثلاثة} أي: ينقسم الناس يوم القيامة إلى ثلاثة أصناف: قوم عن يمين العرش

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r3.claim: The same three categories appear at the end of the sura at people’s death and in 35:32, on one interpretation of “wronging oneself” discussed earlier.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r3.anchor: وهكذا قسمهم إلى هذه الأنواع الثلاثة في آخر السورة وقت احتضارهم، وهكذا ذكرهم في قوله تعالى:

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r10.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r10.speaker: رسول الله
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r10.claim: The Prophet explains paired souls as like-minded peers: each person is grouped with others who did the same deeds, in correspondence with the three classes.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p515/r10.anchor: عن النعمان بن بشير قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم:

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r2.speaker: عائشة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r2.claim: The Prophet says the foremost to the shade on Resurrection Day are those who accept what is due when given, give when asked, and judge others as they judge themselves.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r2.anchor: عن عائشة، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، أنه قال:

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r3.speaker: محمد بن كعب وأبو حرزة يعقوب بن مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r3.claim: Muhammad ibn Kab and Abu Harza Yaqub ibn Mujahid say the foremost are the prophets.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r3.anchor: وقال محمد بن كعب وأبو حرزة يعقوب بن مجاهد

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r4.speaker: السدي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r4.claim: Al-Suddi identifies the foremost as the people of Illiyyin.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas names Joshua son of Nun as preceding Moses, the believer of Yasin as preceding Jesus, and Ali ibn Abi Talib as preceding Muhammad.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r6.speaker: محمد بن أبي حماد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r6.claim: Ibn Sirin says the foremost are those who prayed toward both qiblas.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r6.anchor: عن قرة، عن ابن سيرين: {والسابقون السابقون} الذين صلوا للقبلتين

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r7.speaker: الحسن وقتادة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r7.claim: Al-Hasan and Qatada say the foremost are people from every community.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r7.anchor: وقال الحسن وقتادة: {والسابقون السابقون} أي: من كل أمة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r8.speaker: عثمان بن أبي سودة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r8.claim: Uthman ibn Abi Sawda comments that they are the first to go to the mosque and the first to set out in God’s cause.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r8.anchor: عن عثمان بن أبي سودة أنه قرأ هذه الآية: {والسابقون السابقون. أولئك المقربون} ثم قال: أولهم رواحا إلى المسجد

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r9.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r9.claim: These views can all be true: the foremost are those who hasten to commanded good works; those who race to good in this life are foremost in honor in the next, since recompense matches deeds, and they are brought near in gardens.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r9.anchor: وهذه الأقوال كلها صحيحة، فإن المراد بالسابقين هم المبادرون إلى فعل الخيرات كما أمروا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r1.speaker: عبد الله بن عمرو
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r1.claim: Abdullah ibn Amr says angels asked God to give them the Hereafter since Adam’s children had worldly food, drink, and marriage; after three appeals God refused to equate those He created by hand with one brought into being by “Be,” then Abdullah recited these verses.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r1.anchor: عن عبد الله بن عمرو قال: قالت الملائكة: يا رب، جعلت لبني آدم الدنيا فهم يأكلون ويشربون ويتزوجون

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r2.speaker: عثمان بن سعيد الدارمي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r2.claim: Al-Darimi’s version in Refutation of the Jahmiyya says God will not equate the righteous offspring of one created by His hand with one He created by saying “Be.”
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r2.anchor: في كتابه: "الرد على الجهمية"، ولفظه: فقال الله عز وجل

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r7.speaker: ابن سيرين
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r7.claim: Ibn Sīrīn identifies the foremost as those who prayed toward both qiblas.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r7.anchor: قيل: هم الذين صلوا إلى القبلتين، عن ابن سيرين

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r8.speaker: أبو علي
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r8.claim: Abū ʿAlī says they first followed the prophets, became leaders in guidance, and were foremost in God's abundant reward.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r8.anchor: وقيل: السابقون إلى اتباع الأنبياء، فصاروا أئمة في الهدى، فهم السابقون إلى جزيل الثواب عند الله، عن أبي علي

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r9.claim: Another explanation is that they first obeyed God and so were first to receive His mercy.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r9.anchor: وقيل: السابقون إلى طاعة الله: السابقون إلى رحمته

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r10.claim: Another view makes them the earliest arrivals at mosques and the first to set out in God's cause.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r10.anchor: وقيل: السابقون أولهم رواحا إلى المساجد، وأولهم خروجا في سبيل الله

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r11.speaker: ابن عباس
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r11.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies the foremost as first to migrate, and first to enter Paradise.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r11.anchor: وقيل: السابقون إلى الهجرة، وهم السابقون إلى الجنة، عن ابن عباس.

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r12.speaker: علي
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r12.claim: ʿAlī identifies them as those first to perform the five daily prayers.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r12.anchor: وقيل: إلى الصلوات الخمس، عن علي - رضي الله عنه -

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r13.speaker: عكرمة
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r13.claim: ʿIkrima identifies them as those first to embrace Islam.

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r14.speaker: الضحاك
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r14.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk identifies them as those first to undertake jihad.

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r15.speaker: القرظي
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r15.claim: Al-Quraẓī identifies them as those first in every good deed.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r15.anchor: وقيل: إلى كل خير، عن القرظي

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r16.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r16.claim: Saʿīd b. Jubayr says they hasten first to repentance and righteous works.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r16.anchor: يسارعون إليها، عن سعيد بن جبير، وقيل: السابقون إلى ما دعا الله إليه

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r17.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r17.speaker: ابن كيسان
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r17.claim: Ibn Kaysān says they are first in all that God has called people to.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r17.anchor: وقيل: السابقون إلى ما دعا الله إليه، عن ابن كيسان

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r18.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r18.claim: The author prefers Ibn Kaysān's broad reading because it includes the preceding views: the foremost excel in knowledge and deeds, hastening to monotheism, justice, affirming prophets, and all commands.
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r18.anchor: وهذا هو الأوجه؛ لأن الكلام عام، فيحمل على جميع ما تقدم، [وكأن] المراد من عظم محله في العلم والعمل

JISHUMI:v9p6740/r19.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r19.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r19.claim: One account divides people into a lifelong doer of good (foremost), a sinner who later repents (right), and a lifelong persistently wicked person (left).
JISHUMI:v9p6740/r19.anchor: وقيل: الناس ثلاثة: رجل ابتكر الخير في حداثة سنه وداوم عليه حتى خرج من الدنيا، فهو السابق

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r1.claim: The foremost are the sincere who hastened to answer God's call and raised dust seeking His pleasure.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r1.anchor: المخلصون الذين سبقوا إلى ما دعاهم الله إليه وشقوا الغبار

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r2.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r2.claim: One account makes the early, persistent doers of good the foremost brought near; late repenters the people of the right; and those who persist in youthful evil the people of the left.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r2.anchor: وقيل : الناس ثلاثة فرجل ابتكر الخير في حداثة سنه ، ثم داوم عليه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r4.claim: The repetition means the foremost whose standing and description already reached the listener, and serves as emphasis.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r4.anchor: يريد : والسابقون من عرفت حالهم وبلغك وصفهم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r5.speaker: أبو النجم
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r5.claim: Abu al-Najm's وشعري شعري illustrates the construction: poetry already known for eloquence and excellence.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r6.claim: أولئك المقربون is the predicate; the sound pause is after the second السابقون, completing the clause in parallel with the other groups.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r6.anchor: ووقف بعضهم على : والسابقون ؛ وابتدأ السابقون أولئك المقربون

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r20.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r20.speaker: محمد بن كعب
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r20.anchor: أحدها : أنهم الأنبياء ، قاله محمد بن كعب .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r21.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r21.speaker: الحسن وقتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r21.claim: They are those who were first to believe in each community.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r21.anchor: الثاني : أنهم الأسبقون إلى الإيمان من كل أمة ، قاله الحسن ، وقتادة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r22.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r22.speaker: ابن سيرين
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r22.claim: They are those who prayed facing both qiblas.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r22.anchor: الثالث : أنهم الذين صلوا إلى القبلتين , قاله ابن سيرين .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r23.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r23.speaker: عثمان بن أبي سوادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r23.claim: They are the first to go to mosques and the quickest to set out in God's path.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r23.anchor: الرابع : هم أول الناس رواحا إلى المساجد وأسرعهم خفوفا في سبيل الله , قاله عثمان بن أبي سوادة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r24.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r24.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r24.claim: Four are singled out: Hizqil among Moses' people, Habib al-Najjar among Jesus' people, and Abu Bakr and Umar among Muhammad's people.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r24.anchor: وسابقان من أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وهما : أبو بكر وعمر ، قاله ابن عباس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r25.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r25.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r25.claim: A sixth possibility is the Muslims who accepted Islam in Mecca before the Prophet's emigration and in Medina before his arrival there, before hope or fear drove people to Islam.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r25.anchor: ويحتمل سادسا : أنهم الذي أسلموا بمكة قبل هجرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وبالمدينة قبل هجرته إليهم لأنهم سبقوا بالإسلام قبل زمان الرغبة والرهبة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r26.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r26.speaker: الكلبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r26.claim: They raced to faith in worldly life and will race to Paradise in the afterlife; these are the near ones.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r26.anchor: أحدهما : السابقون في الدنيا إلى الإيمان ، السابقون في الآخرة إلى الجنة هم المقربون ، قاله الكلبي .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r27.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r27.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r27.claim: Another possibility is that those first to believe in their respective prophets are the foremost and near ones among their communities.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r27.anchor: الثاني : يحتمل أنهم المؤمنون بالأنبياء في زمانهم , وسابقوهم بالإيمان هم المقربون المقدمون منهم .

MUQATIL:56:7-18/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:56:7-18/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:56:7-18/r4.claim: Abu Bakr and Ali are among the foremost; they are first in belief in God and His Messenger among each community and are first to Paradise.
MUQATIL:56:7-18/r4.anchor: إلى الأنبياء منهم أبو بكر، وعلى، رضى الله عنهما، هم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p207/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p207/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p207/r1.claim: The foremost are those who race ahead to the gardens; alternatively, the second occurrence repeats the first for emphasis and the predicate follows.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p207/r1.anchor: إلى الجنات وقيل الثانى تأكيد للاول والخبر

NASAFI-FULL:v4p207#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p207#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p207#2/r1.claim: Nasafi judges the first parsing of “the foremost” as predicate more apt than treating it as emphatic repetition.

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r4.claim: A report cited by al-Mahdawī says the foremost accept their due when given, give when asked, and judge others as they would themselves.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r4.anchor: روي عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r5.speaker: محمد بن كعب القرظي
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r5.claim: Muḥammad ibn Kaʿb al-Quraẓī says the foremost are the prophets.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r5.anchor: وقال محمد بن كعب القرظي: إنهم الأنبياء

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r6.speaker: الحسن وقتادة وعكرمة
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r6.claim: Al-Ḥasan, Qatāda, and, similarly, ʿIkrima say they are the first in each community to believe.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r6.anchor: الحسن وقتادة: السابقون إلى الإيمان من كل أمة. ونحوه عن عكرمة

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r7.speaker: محمد بن سيرين
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r7.claim: Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn says they are those who prayed toward both qiblas, citing 9:100 as evidence.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r7.anchor: محمد بن سيرين: هم الذين صلوا إلى القبلتين دليله قوله تعالى

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r8.speaker: مجاهد وغيره
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r8.claim: Mujāhid and others say they are first to jihad and among the first to go out to prayer.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r8.anchor: وقال مجاهد وغيره: هم السابقون إلى الجهاد، وأول الناس رواحا إلى الصلاة

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r9.speaker: علي
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r9.claim: ʿAlī says they are those who take precedence in the five daily prayers.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r9.anchor: وقال علي رضي الله عنه: هم السابقون إلى الصلوات الخمس

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r10.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r10.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says they are those who take precedence in jihad.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r10.anchor: الضحاك: إلى الجهاد. سعيد بن جبير: إلى التوبة

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r11.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r11.claim: Saʿīd ibn Jubayr says they are first to repent and do righteous works, linking the idea to 3:133 and 23:61.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r11.anchor: سعيد بن جبير: إلى التوبة وأعمال البر قال الله تعالى

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r12.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r12.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās, as cited by al-Māwardī, names four pioneers: Ḥizqīl of Pharaoh's family for Moses' community, Ḥabīb al-Najjār of Antioch for Jesus' community, and Abū Bakr and ʿUmar for Muḥammad's community.

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r13.speaker: شميط بن عجلان
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r13.claim: Shumayṭ ibn ʿAjlān describes three endings: persistent early goodness makes one a foremost intimate; repentance after sin makes one of the right; persistence in sin makes one of the left.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r13.anchor: وقال شميط بن العجلان: الناس ثلاثة فرجل ابتكر للخير في حداثة سنه داوم عليه

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r14.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r14.claim: Another view includes anyone who takes precedence in any righteous deed.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r14.anchor: وقيل: هم كل من سبق إلى شيء من أشياء الصلاح

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r15.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r15.claim: One analysis makes the first al-sābiqūn a subject, the second an emphatic repetition, and “those are the brought-near” the predicate.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r15.anchor: ثم قيل: { السابقون } رفع بالابتداء والثاني توكيد له والخبر { أولئك المقربون }.

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r16.speaker: الزجاج
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r16.claim: Al-Zajjāj instead makes the first al-sābiqūn the subject and the second its predicate: those who precede in obedience also precede to God's mercy; verse 11 describes them.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r16.anchor: وقال الزجاج: { السابقون } رفع بالابتداء والثاني خبره والمعنى السابقون إلى طاعة الله
